annotation: The participant waved their left hand back and forth, grimaced slightly, and squinted.
The participant clapped their hands, swayed slightly, put their hands behind their back, and tilted their face slightly upwards.
The participant placed their hands behind them, turned their face slightly upward and to the right, and scrunched their face and frowned.
The participant tilted their head to the right, nodded, and scratched their neck with their left hand.
The participant turned their face to the left, looked down, and covered their mouth with their left hand, touching their nose.
